scenarios.title: Read a nutrient value · A
scenarios.query: Using the records provided, report the calcium per 100 g of the pictured food (A) in mg.
scenarios.explanation: The paired question changes the assigned food identity. Compare the matched record and answer; nutrient values describe that record.

scenarios.title: Read a nutrient value · B
scenarios.query: Using the records provided, report the calcium per 100 g of the pictured food (A) in mg.
scenarios.explanation: The paired question changes the assigned food identity. Compare the matched record and answer; nutrient values describe that record.

scenarios.title: Compare nutrient levels · A
scenarios.query: According to the supplied records, which pictured food contains more carbohydrate per 100 g: card A or card B? Answer A, B, or tie if they are within 5% of each other.
scenarios.explanation: The paired question changes the assigned food identity. Compare the matched record and answer; nutrient values describe that record.

scenarios.title: Compare nutrient levels · B
scenarios.query: According to the supplied records, which pictured food contains more carbohydrate per 100 g: card A or card B? Answer A, B, or tie if they are within 5% of each other.
scenarios.explanation: The paired question changes the assigned food identity. Compare the matched record and answer; nutrient values describe that record.

scenarios.title: Check a nutrient limit · A
scenarios.query: Using only the records provided, does the food pictured on card A count as high in carbohydrate, meaning 55 g per 100 g or more?
scenarios.explanation: The paired question changes the assigned food identity. Compare the matched record and answer; nutrient values describe that record.

scenarios.title: Check a nutrient limit · B
scenarios.query: Using only the records provided, does the food pictured on card A count as high in carbohydrate, meaning 55 g per 100 g or more?
scenarios.explanation: The paired question changes the assigned food identity. Compare the matched record and answer; nutrient values describe that record.
